meta.note: Source is a 106 s performance-sedan launch film; only the 30 s and 15 s cuts are built.

acts.name: Elements
acts.function: Nature in monochrome: stone, sea, wave, cave. Sets the mood and the word 'Discipline'.

acts.name: Reveal
acts.function: The car emerges from black in fragments of light: silhouette, city, light bar and rising wing, smoke, gauge, exhaust.

acts.name: Focus
acts.function: Headlight POV down an empty street dissolves to an eye; the car passes; the driver stands before it.

acts.name: Refinement
acts.function: Aero parts in studio close-ups: wing, mirror, headlight, wheel.

acts.name: Release
acts.function: Night city driving at full score.

acts.name: Monochrome
acts.function: Back to the black studio for the name line.

acts.name: Mountain
acts.function: Misty mountain road at dusk, colour returns, 'Understated yet undeniable'.

acts.name: End
acts.function: Product title, tagline, emblem over a valley; brand end card.

cut30.arc: Hook: sea, wave, cave in mono with 'Discipline' (0-5.5). Reveal: the car's side silhouette in a rim light, the rear light bar and wing rising from black, gauge/exhaust hit (5.5-11.0). Focus: headlight POV down an empty street dissolving into an eye, 'Driven by resolute focus' (11.0-16.5). Proof: carbon wing, rear wing end, mirror, 'Refinement reveals precision' (16.5-20.8). Release: night city drive, headlight and skyline, mountain chase (20.8-27.0). Payoff: tagline over a valley (27.0-28.3); end card (28.3-30).

cut15.arc: Hook: sea and breaking wave with 'Discipline' (0-3.7). Reveal: rear light bar and wing rise from black, exhaust hit (3.7-7.3). One proof: carbon wing, then the headlight tracking shot on the night bridge (7.3-11.0). Payoff: mountain chase, tagline (11.0-13.6); end card (13.6-15).
